system.description:
You have reserves of endurance far beyond those of normal people.

  • You have advantage on checks for tests of endurance (marching for hours without rest, going without sleep, surviving without food or water, etc

  • You can hold your breath for twice as fast as normal

  • You have advantage on Death Checks

  • When you are reduced to zero stamina, you are not Stunned, though you must still make Death Checks as normal
